hero.title: Drive Engagement with Sell-Side AI Decisioning
hero.subtitle: Optimize every impression in real time to maximize click-through rates (CTR) and video completion rates (VCR) with custom AI PMPs.

impact.title: Optimize for What Drives Action
impact.description: Whether your goal is to increase CTR for a direct response campaign or improve VCR for a video awareness push, optimizing with basic heuristics like site lists or viewability isn’t enough. Our sell-side AI decisioning engine trains on your campaign-level engagement signals - clicks, plays, and completions - to deliver real-time curation that drives:

items.title: Higher CTR for display and native
Higher VCR for video and CTV
Cut waste on low value impressions

The trained model is deployed on the sell side to curate a PMP of impressions most likely to generate clicks or completions.
A unique PMP deal ID is generated for DSP activation.

why.description: While DSPs play a key role in media performance, they often operate without direct access to impression-level survey, attention, and contextual signals. inPowered AI complements these platforms by optimizing from the source, on the sell side, where data is freshest and decisions can drive real impact.
